observation.detail: No registered tool provides this capability, and no network or package acquisition was used. A stdlib-only Node procedure was authored locally at the path in acquired. It was probed once against input/pilot.observations.json with a separate probe output directory, not the final args. The probe gave row_count 3, scheduled 30, completed 26, incidents 6, completion_percent 86.67, North 22/18/5 (81.82) and South 8/8/1 (100). I rechecked these totals with a separate Node reduction, and a second run produced byte-identical output. The procedure was authored by this acquisition step and is not a vetted third-party tool. The probe artifacts are evidence only. Final deliverables must come from a fresh invocation with the fixed args.
